transcript: Speaker A: Did you see that meme I sent? Speaker B: Haha, yeah, the one about the interview? Hilarious. Speaker C: Haan bhai, funny tha. [Yeah brother, it was funny. The meme was in English, I didn't fully understand it, but I laughed because everyone else was laughing. Every day, memes in English are sent in the group, I just send emojis because I don't know how to reply in English. My friendship with these two is 10 years old. In school we were all the same, in college we were all the same, but after college everything changed. Sahil joined an MNC, his English became fluent. Vivek did an MBA, he gives presentations. And me? I'm still there. I think in Hindi, I speak in Hindi. Earlier it didn't matter, but now it does. Plans in the group are made in English, I stay quiet. Memes in English, I send emojis. Networking events, I say no. Slowly I am getting left out of the group, not physically but mentally. One night Sahil asked, 'Bro, you've been quiet lately. Everything okay?' I said, 'Yes, everything is fine.' But Sahil understood. He said, 'Amit, it's because of English, right?' I remained quiet. He said, 'There is an app, English Seekho. Try it, I will also help you.' I opened the General English show. 'Start conversation with Hello' was watched by 165,000 people. It was explained in Hindi. I watched 10 easy sentences daily. Daily English, watched 'tell about yourself', my introduction. In the Spoken English show, I watched 'English for the first meeting'. Watched 'how to talk in a networking event', 'learn to praise', 'giving compliments in English'. Practiced with the AI Coach for 15 minutes daily. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said, 'Your friends are fluent, you won't be able to learn.' After a month, Vivek said, 'There is a networking event on Saturday. Amit, are you coming?' I said, 'Yeah, I'm in. Let's go.' Both looked at each other. Went to the event. Met a guy, I asked, 'So what do you do?' I said, 'I work in digital marketing. I handle campaign strategy and performance analysis. Been doing it for about three years now.' The guy said, 'That's interesting. We should connect on LinkedIn.' Came home and wrote in the group, 'Guys, great event. Made some solid connections. Let's do this more often.' Sahil replied, 'Bro, is that you?' I said, 'Yeah bro, the new me.' Download the English Seekho app. Open the General English show. Start with 'Start conversation with Hello'. Practice with the AI Coach for 15 minutes daily. Don't stay quiet in your friend group. In one month, you will speak in the same group and everyone will listen. Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

After his friend recommends the 'English Seekho' app, Amit practices daily using its structured lessons and AI Coach. He successfully speaks English at a networking event and regains his confidence, prompting a call to action to download the app.
